pain_points: Highly imbalanced datasets and rare event prediction
Hyperparameter tuning sensitivity and computational expense of grid search
Inadequacy of standard evaluation metrics (accuracy, MSE) for extreme/critical meteorological events
Pitfalls and misinterpretations in Explainable AI (XAI)
extraction_notes: Document is an informational webpage/announcement for an AMS short course held on January 12, 2025. No specific datasets, source code links, or specific ML model architectures (beyond TensorFlow usage and general techniques like synthetic minority oversampling and XAI) are detailed.
